provenance.caveat: Data: NASA/DLR GRACE and NASA/GFZ GRACE-FO satellites, which weigh the water on land by its gravity; JPL mascon solution RL06.3, blocks of about 300 km (the map averages them into 2° squares). The trend is a straight line through 2003–2025; it shows what changed, not why. The record is 23 years long, shorter than the 30 years usually used to describe a climate. GRACE weighs all water together (it cannot say whether groundwater, soil or snow changed), sees blocks of about 300 km, and has no data from mid-2017 to mid-2018 between the two missions; months without data are left out, never filled.
